companion.en: In this episode, we'll meet a home companion robot called Abi, who's making friends with the elderly residents of Melbourne in Australia.
companion.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将结识一款名为Abi的家庭伴侣机器人，它正在和澳大利亚墨尔本的老年居民们交朋友。

companion.en: They would be consumed by flesh-eating maggots or larvae, they would be blinded by little worms, there were all manner of diseases and threats that killed or crippled his travelling companions.
companion.zh: 他们会被食肉蛆虫或幼虫侵蚀，会被小虫子弄瞎双眼，有各种各样的疾病和威胁杀死了或致残了他的同伴。

compensate.en: Here, for example, the brain works harder to compensate for a weaker sound signal reaching the inner ear.
compensate.zh: 例如，在这里，大脑会更加努力地工作，以弥补到达内耳的较弱声音信号。

compensate.en: Mines back on Earth would be closed, millions of people would be out of a job, and there would need to be some sort of mechanism for these countries to be compensated by the countries or companies that enjoyed the spoils of asteroid mining.
compensate.zh: 地球上的矿山将会关闭，成百上千万人将失去工作，而且需要建立某种机制，由享受小行星采矿战果的国家或公司向这些国家提供补偿。

complain.en: They twitched and shook, cried out in pain, and complained of being pinched or bitten.
complain.zh: 她们抽搐颤抖，痛苦哭喊，抱怨自己被掐或被咬。

complain.en: Call centre work involves dealing with customers who've phoned up to complain.
complain.zh: 呼叫中心的工作包括应对打电话来投诉的客户。

complain.en: Don’t just go to the supermarket and buy a sandwich and complain that British food is bad.
complain.zh: 不要只是去超市买个三明治，然后抱怨英国食物难吃。

complain.en: Barbara complains she can't swim against the current.
complain.zh: Barbara 抱怨说她不能逆流而上。

complain.en: When I studied in London, I had two friends from France and Spain who used to complain about British food all the time.
complain.zh: 我在伦敦读书时，有两个来自法国和西班牙的朋友，他们过去总是抱怨英国食物。

consist.en: You said 80%, and the answer is 90%. Our blood consists of around 90% water.
consist.zh: 你说是80%，答案是90%。我们的血液大约由90%的水分组成。

consist.en: I mentioned that over half the human body consists of water, but there's an even higher percentage of water in our blood.
consist.zh: 我提到人体的一半以上由水组成，但我们血液中的水分比例甚至更高。

consist.en: What exactly is the manosphere? Here's Anita Rani, presenter of BBC Radio 4's Woman's Hour, with one definition: The manosphere consists of online communities and influencers that promote the idea that emotional control, material wealth, physical appearance and dominance, especially over women, are markers of male worth.
consist.zh: '男性圈'到底是什么？下面是 BBC 广播四台节目《Woman's Hour》主持人 Anita Rani 给出的一种定义：'男性圈'由一些网络社群和网红组成，他们宣扬的观念是：情绪控制力、物质财富、外貌形象以及支配地位——尤其是对女性的支配——是衡量男性价值的标准。

consist.en: This iconic descent took place in something called a Bathyscaphe, which looks a little bit like an airship, a Zeppelin, and consists of a small round pressure sphere at the bottom, where the two men would sit, and a large collection of tanks filled with gasoline in order to keep the device buoyant.
consist.zh: 这次标志性的下潜是在一种叫做“里雅斯特号”深海潜水器（Bathyscaphe）的设备中进行的，它看起来有点像飞艇或齐柏林飞艇，由底部的圆形耐压球体（两名男子坐在那里）和一大批充满汽油的舱体组成，以保持装置的浮力。

comment.en: Or they go online and leave comments on YouTube videos or blog articles.
comment.zh: 或者他们上网在YouTube视频或博客文章下留言。

comment.en: Let me know in the comments below, if you're listening somewhere where you can comment.
comment.zh: 如果你在某个可以评论的地方收听，请在下方的评论区告诉我。

comment.en: Let me know in the comments below, if you're listening somewhere where you can comment.
comment.zh: 如果你在某个可以评论的地方收听，请在下方的评论区告诉我。

comment.en: She comments that Donald Trump is a fan of social media by saying he has a soft spot for TikTok.
comment.zh: 她评论说唐纳德·特朗普是社交媒体的粉丝，并说他对 TikTok 情有独钟。

comment.en: I release them on Mondays and Fridays. And leave a comment in English on at least one of those episodes.
comment.zh: 我在周一和周五发布。并且在其中至少一期节目下用英文留言评论。

conventional.en: But he quickly discovered that his talents lay beyond conventional soldiering.
conventional.zh: 但他很快发现，自己的才能并不在常规的军旅生涯中。

conventional.en: So, obviously he's not giving us the conventional: "Oh, good afternoon, Mr Rosen," or a more formal approach.
conventional.zh: 所以，很显然，他没有给我们那种传统的：“哦，下午好，Rosen先生”，或者更正式的方式。

conventional.en: They could not win a conventional war against the Ottomans.
conventional.zh: 他们无法在常规战争中战胜奥斯曼人。

conventional.en: On his release, he tried his hand at a more conventional life, becoming a salesman, but it wasn't for him.
conventional.zh: 出狱后，他尝试过一种更常规的生活，做了一名推销员，但这并不适合他。

conservation.en: Conservation is the protection of plants, animals and the natural world from human harm.
conservation.zh: 保护（Conservation）是指保护植物、动物和自然世界免受人类伤害。

conservation.en: Today, conservation efforts, including protecting endangered animals and restoring habitats, usually depends on evolutionary principles.
conservation.zh: 今天，包括保护濒危动物和恢复栖息地在内的保护工作，通常都依赖于进化原则。

conservation.en: I remember myself going to see lowland gorillas at Zoo Atlanta every single year, and the point of this was to introduce us to conservation.
conservation.zh: 我记得自己每年都去亚特兰大动物园看低地大猩猩，这样做的目的就是为了让我们了解自然保护。

conservation.en: Darwin’s work also transformed how we study ecosystems and conservation, by showing that species are connected through ancestry and shaped by their environment.
conservation.zh: Darwin的工作还彻底改变了我们研究生态系统和保护工作的方式，它表明物种通过祖先相连并由环境塑造。

confine.en: Historically, it had been where knowledge and learning was confined to.
confine.zh: 从历史上看，知识和学问一直被局限在教会里。

confine.en: Unlike Skull and Bones or the Knights Templar, Freemasonry isn’t confined to a single institution or hidden in history.
confine.zh: 与骷髅会或圣殿骑士团不同，共济会并不局限于某一单一机构，也没有隐匿于历史之中。

confine.en: George III was now confined to Windsor Castle.
confine.zh: George III 此时已被禁锢在温莎城堡中。

confine.en: Zoochosis is a term to describe the repeated, purposeless behaviour performed by captive animals in response to the stress of being confined, including pacing, head-bobbing and swaying.
confine.zh: 动物园精神病（Zoochosis）是一个术语，用来描述圈养动物为了应对被关押的压力而表现出的重复、无目的的行为，包括踱步、点头和摇晃。

confine.en: Here's Danielle Reed, researcher at the Monell Chemical Senses Center in Philadelphia explaining more to BBC World Service programme, 'The Food Chain': …when we first started doing genetic studies, we really just confined ourselves to looking at a few Europeans, people of European ancestry.
confine.zh: 下面是费城莫奈尔化学感官中心研究员 Danielle Reed 在 BBC 世界服务频道节目《The Food Chain》中的进一步解释：……我们刚开始做基因研究的时候，其实只局限于研究少数欧洲人，也就是欧洲血统的人群。

commodity.en: It turned iron, and later steel, from scarce, expensive materials into industrial commodities.
commodity.zh: 它将铁、以及后来的钢，从稀缺、昂贵的材料变成了工业大宗商品。

commodity.en: Rice is a commodity, a produce that can be bought and sold.
commodity.zh: 大米是一种商品，一种可以买卖的农产品。

commodity.en: Much of Southeast Asia’s tin and rubber came from the Malay Peninsula, so Singapore was the perfect place to export these commodities.
commodity.zh: 东南亚的大部分锡和橡胶都来自马来半岛，因此新加坡是出口这些大宗商品的完美地点。

commodity.en: OK, let’s recap the vocabulary we’ve learned in this programme, starting with commodity, a product, like rice, that can be bought and sold.
commodity.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下本期节目中学习的词汇，首先是 commodity（商品），像大米这样可以买卖的产品。

convincing.en: So, what happened? Why has Keir Starmer resigned after such a convincing election victory?
convincing.zh: 那么，究竟发生了什么？为什么Keir Starmer在取得如此令人信服的大选胜利后会辞职呢？

convincing.en: Trust us. Follow our instructions. The shock generator the teacher was shown looked convincing.
convincing.zh: 相信我们，照我们说的做。“教师”看到的电击发生器，外观十分逼真可信。

convincing.en: But…it didn’t matter. North Korea was not interested in convincing anyone, anyone outside its borders, that was.
convincing.zh: 但……这些都不重要。朝鲜根本无意说服任何人——至少不打算说服国境之外的任何人。

convincing.en: She uses the phrase a number of to mean several, but it also makes her statement more convincing, because of course several studies are better than just one.
convincing.zh: 她用“a number of”这个短语来表示“几个”，但这也让她的陈述更具说服力，因为当然，几项研究总比仅仅一项要好。

convincing.en: This might make for a nice line in a poem, but the reality of convincing someone to risk their life for an abstract ideal like glory or loyalty, especially before the modern idea of nationhood, well, it was difficult.
convincing.zh: 这或许能拼凑出一首好诗，但要说服某人为诸如荣誉或忠诚之类的抽象理想去冒生命危险，特别是在现代国家观念出现之前，现实中，嗯，这很困难。

coffin.en: T he final nail in the coffin was the global financial crisis in 2008/2009.
coffin.zh: 党政最后的一抻是 2008年至 2009 年的全球金融卅机。

coffin.en: It was a disastrous decision, the nail in the coffin for the sick man of Europe.
coffin.zh: 这是一个灾难性的决定，是压垮欧洲病夫的最后一根稻草。

coffin.en: And finally, the idiom, the final nail in the coffin, refers to an event that causes the final end of something that had already started to fail.
coffin.zh: 最后，习语 the final nail in the coffin，指的是导致某个本就已经开始走下坡的事物彻底结束的事件。

correspondent.en: But is that really possible to measure? Well, here is former BBC education correspondent Sean Coughlan talking to BBC World Service programme 'The Global Story'.
correspondent.zh: 但这真的能衡量吗？这里是前BBC教育记者Sean Coughlan在接受BBC世界服务部节目《The Global Story》采访时的谈话。

correspondent.en: He graduated from high school in 2003, and rather than going straight to university or trying to get a job, he enlisted in the military as what’s called a “combat correspondent”, essentially a military journalist, someone who follows the troops, takes pictures, and writes articles.
correspondent.zh: 他在2003年从高中毕业，但没有直接去上大学或尝试找工作，而是参军成了一名所谓的“战斗记者”（combat correspondent），本质上就是一名军事记者，负责跟随部队、拍照并撰写文章。

confidential.en: The adjective confidential means kept private and secret and describes information which is not shared with anyone else.
confidential.zh: 形容词 confidential 的意思是保密的、机密的，用来描述不与其他人分享的信息。

confidential.en: I bring transparency to the conversation, and own it, and say that I'm going to be asking you some quite personal questions, and there may be also intimate examination… I want to assure you that this is confidential, that this is a safe, non-judgmental space…
confidential.zh: 我在谈话中会保持透明，主动承担，并告诉对方我接下来要问一些相当私人的问题，可能还会有一些比较私密的检查……我想向你保证这是保密的，这是一个安全、不带评判的空间……

consolidate.en: At the same time, Putin worked to consolidate political power.
consolidate.zh: 与此同时，普京致力于巩固政治权力。

consolidate.en: The deep, dreaming sleep that consolidates memory, repairs the body, and allows the brain to do its work.
consolidate.zh: 这种巩固记忆、修复身体、让大脑发挥作用的深度做梦睡眠。

consolidate.en: MBS had engineered a quiet, behind-the-scenes coup, consolidating power in a manner unseen since the kingdom's founding.
consolidate.zh: MBS策划了一场悄无声息的幕后政变，以王国建国以来前所未有的方式巩固了权力。

consolidate.en: The entire country was being pulled apart by competing forces, and Mobutu, far from being a neutral arbiter, was quietly consolidating power in the background.
consolidate.zh: 整个国家被互相竞争的势力四分五裂，而蒙博托非但不是一个中立的仲裁者，反而在幕后悄悄地巩固权力。

consolidate.en: Trump and his administration warmly embraced the young crown prince, announcing major arms deals, praising his reforms, and offering the kind of diplomatic support MBS needed as he consolidated power at home.
consolidate.zh: 特朗普及其政府热烈拥抱这位年轻的王储，宣布了重大军售，赞扬他的改革，并提供了MBS在国内巩固权力所需的某种外交支持。

court.en: This is the reality of the Crown Court system in England and Wales in 2026.
court.zh: 这就是2026年英格兰和威尔士刑事法院系统的现实状况。

court.en: The case went to trial at the Old Bailey, England's most famous criminal court.
court.zh: 此案在英国最著名的刑事法院 Old Bailey 开庭审理。

court.en: Second, and perhaps more importantly, he was appointed Chief of the Royal Court.
court.zh: 其次，或许也是更重要的是，他被任命为王室法院主管（办公厅主任）。

court.en: And the court would interpret the laws. Each branch of government could limit each other.
court.zh: 法院解释法律。政府的每个分支都可以互相制衡。

court.en: And in 2019, the US Supreme Court ruled that courts cannot stop gerrymandering.
court.zh: 在2019年，美国最高法院裁定法院不能阻止gerrymandering。

concert.en: Actually, Taylor Swift's Edinburgh show wasn't the first music concert to trigger seismic waves.
concert.zh: 事实上，Taylor Swift的爱丁堡演出并不是第一场引发地震波的音乐会。

concert.en: Sadly, the answer to Georgie's question is 'no' – the Taylor Swift concert wasn't technically an earthquake.
concert.zh: 遗憾的是，Georgie的问题的答案是“否定”的——Taylor Swift的演唱会从技术上讲并不是一次地震。

concert.en: He has relaxed some long-standing restrictions—women can now drive, cinemas have reopened, concerts are allowed, and the infamous secret police have been stripped of much of their power.
concert.zh: 他放松了一些长期存在的限制——女性现在可以开车了，电影院重新开业了，音乐会得到了允许，臭名昭著的宗教警察也被剥夺了大部分权力。

comparable.en: And finally, the adjective comparable means similar in size, amount, or quality.
comparable.zh: 最后，形容词comparable（可比的）意为在大小、数量或质量上相似。

comparable.en: According to one report from 2019, ‘the UK is more regionally divided than any comparable advanced economy’.
comparable.zh: 根据2019年的一份报告，“在所有同类发达经济体中，英国的区域分化是最严重的”。

comparable.en: In fact, in the 16th century, English food was comparable, similar, to the food being eaten by ordinary people in Europe.
comparable.zh: 事实上，在16世纪，英国食物与欧洲普通人吃的东西不相上下，非常相似。

comparable.en: Yes, the energy created by the music's sound waves and thousands of fans jumping did move the earth, but not in a way that's comparable, or similar, to a real earthquake.
comparable.zh: 是的，由音乐声波和成千上万粉丝跳跃产生的能量确实移动了地球，但其方式与真正的地震不具可比性，也不相似。

complete.en: Having a balance between the two gives you a more complete sense of progress.
complete.zh: 在两者之间保持平衡能让你对进步有更完整的感知。

complete.en: A “cradle of civilization” is where we see this complete change in human life.
complete.zh: “文明的摇篮”就是我们见证人类生活发生这种彻底变革的地方。

complete.en: The assistants helped to complete the main artist’s projects, especially their larger projects.
complete.zh: 助手们协助完成主艺术家的项目，尤其是他们的大型项目。

complete.en: The move was completed in the beginning of the 17th century, around the year 1611.
complete.zh: 这次迁都于 17 世纪初完成，大约在 1611 年左右。

complete.en: That it might have led to a complete rethink of housing as an investment vehicle.
complete.zh: 这可能会促使人们对作为投资工具的住房进行彻底的反思。

controversy.en: Well, I think the controversy is whether to add cream or jam first.
controversy.zh: 嗯，我认为争论的焦点是先加奶油还是先加果酱。

controversy.en: But it also sparked intense controversy, especially among religious communities.
controversy.zh: 但它也引发了激烈的争议，尤其是在宗教界。

controversy.en: However, with this rise to prominence came controversy.
controversy.zh: 然而，伴随着这种名声鹊起而来的是争议。

controversy.en: And then there were some big political controversies.
controversy.zh: 接着还发生了一些重大的政治争议。

controversy.en: However, almost immediately, the controversy started.
controversy.zh: 然而，争议几乎立刻就开始了。

composition.en: Composition is the arrangement of elements in a painting.
composition.zh: 构图是指画作中各个元素的排列。

composition.en: It takes years of training, a truly exceptional sense of smell, and an ability to create complex, layered compositions.
composition.zh: 这需要多年的训练、真正卓越的嗅觉，以及创造复杂、多层香调组合的能力。

composition.en: Leonardo also paid attention to composition.
composition.zh: 列奥纳多还十分注重构图。

composition.en: Ole makes a liquid by mixing clay and water which changes the soil composition and kick-starts the growth of his trees – the liquid makes the trees start growing more quickly.
composition.zh: 奥莱通过将粘土和水混合制成一种液体，改变了土壤成分，并加速了他树木的生长——这种液体让树木开始生长得更快。

commerce.en: Archeologists have found tools and jewelry and pottery, and also seals used for commerce.
commerce.zh: 考古学家发现了工具、珠宝和陶器，以及用于商业的印章。

commerce.en: This position was incredibly strategic. Any ship traveling between those two seas had to pass by Byzantium, which gave the city huge control over trade and commerce.
commerce.zh: 这个地理位置极具战略意义。任何在两海之间航行的船只都必须经过拜占庭，这使得该市对贸易和商业拥有巨大的控制权。

commerce.en: In January of this year, January of 2026, the German Chancellor, Friedrich Merz, stood in front of the Chamber of Industry and Commerce in Dessau and admitted, in no uncertain terms, that his country, Germany, had made a mistake.
commerce.zh: 今年1月，也就是2026年1月，德国总理 Friedrich Merz 站在德绍工商会前，毫不含糊地承认他的国家——德国，犯了一个错误。

commit.en: The delegates who signed this document were effectively committing treason against the British Crown.
commit.zh: 签署这份文件的代表实际上是在犯下针对英国王室的叛国罪。

commit.en: Lumumba was a fiery orator and committed nationalist who won the country’s first democratic election.
commit.zh: 卢蒙巴是一位慷慨激昂的演说家和坚定的民族主义者，赢得了该国历史上第一次民主选举。

commit.en: The group has been accused of committing war crimes, including targeting civilians, extrajudicial killings, and torture.
commit.zh: 该集团被指控犯下战争罪，包括针对平民、法外处决和酷刑。

commit.en: Zimbardo argued that it showed how ordinary people could commit cruel acts when placed in certain situations.
commit.zh: Zimbardo 认为，它表明普通人在特定情境下，也可能做出残忍的行为。

commit.en: Companies or financial institutions might lie and commit crimes, might commit fraud, in order to gain an advantage.
commit.zh: 公司或金融机构可能会撒谎并实施犯罪，实施欺诈，以此来获得优势。

courtesy.en: And yes, this episode and my voice today are brought to you courtesy of your local data centre.
courtesy.zh: 没错，今天这一期节目和我的声音，也是承蒙你当地的数据中心才得以呈现给你的。

constraint.en: Removing planning constraints sounds simple, but in practice it rarely is.
constraint.zh: 取消规划限制听起来很简单，但在实践中却很少如此。

constraint.en: You give enough context for them to understand the situation, and you apply constraints so that the answer is actually useful.
constraint.zh: 你提供了足够的背景信息让他们理解情况，并且你设定了限制条件，以便答案真正有用。

constraint.en: And then there are the practical constraints.
constraint.zh: 然后还有现实中的限制因素。

constraint.en: So the world's biggest technology companies did something unexpected, or I guess rather obvious when you understand that electricity is their biggest constraint.
constraint.zh: 因此，世界上最大的一些科技公司做了一件出人意料的事，或者说，当你明白电力是他们最大的制约因素时，这其实是显而易见的。

coordinate.en: OPEC fits this definition because its member countries coordinate how much oil they produce.
coordinate.zh: OPEC符合这个定义，因为其成员国会协调各自的石油产量。

coordinate.en: He coordinated the paperwork between police forces and administrative departments across a dozen occupied countries.
coordinate.zh: 他还负责协调十几个被占领国家之间警察部门与行政机构的文书工作。

coordinate.en: As we discussed earlier, OPEC works by coordinating oil production among members.
coordinate.zh: 正如我们之前讨论的那样，OPEC通过协调成员国之间的石油生产来运作。

coordinate.en: Government ministries, military planners, and industrial leaders all worked together to coordinate their war efforts from Berlin.
coordinate.zh: 政府部门、军事规划者和工业领袖都在柏林共同协调他们的战争努力。

contemplate.en: He had been contemplating the idea of obedience, and specifically, the German people's compliance with the Nazi regime.
contemplate.zh: 他一直在思考“服从”这个概念，尤其是德国民众对纳粹政权的顺从。

comply.en: The rates fell, but still many people complied.
comply.zh: 服从率有所下降，但仍有不少人照做。

comply.en: Compliance dropped significantly. More people refused, and some of those who appeared to comply secretly administered lower shocks than the ones they reported.
comply.zh: 服从率大幅下降。更多人选择了拒绝，而一些看似照做的人，实际上偷偷施加了比自己汇报的更低的电压。

counteract.en: If we know all that, then we can begin to build institutions that counteract them.
counteract.zh: 如果我们了解这一切，就可以着手建立能够抵消这些因素的制度。

consistent.en: AI won’t make you fluent. But it can make consistent learners even more effective.
consistent.zh: 人工智能不会让你流利。但它能让坚持学习的人更有效率。

consistent.en: But it’s not just about repetition… it’s about intentional and consistent repetition with feedback.
consistent.zh: 但这不仅仅是重复……而是带着反馈的有意识且持续的重复。

consistent.en: The irony, of course, was that Mobutu wasn’t exactly consistent in his ideology.
consistent.zh: 当然，具有讽刺意味的是，蒙博托的意识形态其实并不那么一致。

consistent.en: My second personal goal was to maintain a consistent gym schedule.
consistent.zh: 我的第二个个人目标是保持规律的健身日程。

consistent.en: I might actually look for an online Japanese teacher to help me stay more consistent this year.
consistent.zh: 我甚至可能会找一个在线日语老师来帮我今年保持更好的连贯性。

corporate.en: This was a new kind of mercenary force—corporate, professional, and deeply tied to modern warfare’s complex logistics.
corporate.zh: 这是一种新型的雇佣兵力量——企业化、专业化，并且深深嵌入到现代战争复杂的后勤中。

corporate.en: It's what corporate employees describe when they implement policies they find troubling but did not choose and cannot individually change.
corporate.zh: 这也是公司员工在执行那些他们觉得有问题、却并非自己选择、也无力单独改变的政策时所描述的状态。

corporate.en: Hence, HENRY… High Earner Not Rich Yet. Most often HENRYs are professionals working in corporate careers in their 20s, 30s, and 40s.
corporate.zh: 因此叫做HENRY……高收入却尚未富裕。通常HENRY是二十多岁、三十多岁和四十多岁在企业界工作的专业人士。

corporate.en: Renaissance condottieri, corporate PMCs, and modern-day groups like Wagner all show us different faces of the same truth: war, for some, is just another business.
corporate.zh: 文艺复兴时期的 condottieri、企业 PMC 以及像瓦格纳这样的现代集团，都向我们展示了同一个真理的不同面孔：对某些人来说，战争只是又一笔生意。

corporate.en: Now, after graduating from Yale, he spent a few years in the legal world, first working for a district judge, and then at a corporate law firm.
corporate.zh: 从耶鲁毕业后，他在法律界度过了几年，先是为一名地方法官工作，后来又在一家企业律所供职。

cottage.zh: 工厂取代了家庭手工业。

cottage.en: He changed his name, enlisted in the Royal Air Force under a false identity, and lived the rest of his life in a self-imposed exile in a 60-metre square cottage in the countryside.
cottage.zh: 他改了名字，以假身份加入英国皇家空军，并在乡下一间 60 平方米的小屋里过着自我放逐的生活。

comedy.en: In American memory, he is a tyrant. In British popular culture, a figure of pity or of gentle comedy.
comedy.zh: 在美国人的记忆中，他是一个暴君。在英国大众文化中，他是一个令人同情或温和滑稽的人物。

comedy.en: The book was illustrated by a celebrated caricaturist and it was given a wonderful title: "The Tragical Comedy or Comical Tragedy of Punch and Judy".
comedy.zh: 这本书由一位著名的漫画家配图，并有一个绝妙的书名：《Punch and Judy 的悲喜剧或滑稽悲剧》。

comedy.en: In fact, the word " slapstick " comes from this world, as in " slapstick comedy", the style of exaggerated comedy where people bang into walls or pretend to hurt themselves.
comedy.zh: 事实上，“slapstick”（滑稽闹剧）这个词就源于这个世界，正如“slapstick comedy”（打闹喜剧）那样，这是一种夸张的喜剧风格，人们会撞到墙上或假装伤害自己。

comedy.en: As I’m sure you know, there are podcasts about everything: comedy, TV shows, business, football, knitting, fishing, obscure historical periods, and, lest I forget, podcasts that help you learn a language.
comedy.zh: 相信大家都知道，播客的主题无所不包：喜剧、电视节目、商业、足球、编织、钓鱼、冷门的历史时期，当然，还有帮助你学习语言的播客。

costume.en: He wore a white costume, a black mask, and he spoke in a strange, squawking voice, a bit like the one you heard a minute ago.
costume.zh: 他穿着白色戏服，戴着黑色面具，说话声音怪异而刺耳，有点像你们刚才听到的那样。

costume.en: Suits and ties were banned from government offices and replaced with a collarless shirt known as the “abacost”, which is short for à bas le costume, or “down with the suit”.
costume.zh: 西装和领带被政府办公室禁用，取而代之的是一种名为“abacost”的无领衬衫，这是法语 à bas le costume（意为“打倒西装”）的简称。

costume.en: Punch also got a new wardrobe. The plain white Italian costume was dropped, and by the middle of the eighteenth century Punch had taken on the red and yellow colours of the English jester, with a tall pointy hat and a stick in his hand.
costume.zh: Punch 还换了新行头。朴素的白色意大利戏服被抛弃了，到了十八世纪中叶，Punch 穿上了英国弄臣的红黄两色服装，戴着一顶高高的尖顶帽，手里拿着一根棍子。

confess.en: Tituba, who’d confessed, was sold to a new owner and disappeared from the records.
confess.zh: 曾经认罪的蒂图芭被卖给了一位新主人，从此在记录中消失了。

confess.en: One who refused to confess was the temple grandmaster, the leader of the order, Jacques de Molay.
confess.zh: 有一个拒绝招供的人是圣殿骑士团大团长雅克·德·莫莱。

confess.en: Or at least, that was the official policy line, and what Otto confessed to in his prepared statement.
confess.zh: 至少，这是官方的口径，也是奥托在那份事先准备好的声明中所"承认"的内容。

confess.en: Next up we have an animal I must confess I don’t enjoy the company of as much as I do dogs, and that is the cat.
confess.zh: 接下来我们要讲的是一种我必须承认自己不像喜欢狗那样喜欢它的动物，那就是猫。

confess.en: In a halting, tearful voice, he delivered a prepared statement confessing to his alleged crimes and begging the North Korean government for forgiveness.
confess.zh: 他用断断续续、带着哭腔的声音，宣读了一份事先准备好的声明，承认了他被指控的罪行，并恳求朝鲜政府的原谅。

corridor.en: He wanders the corridors of the castle in the early hours, agitated and incoherent.
corridor.zh: 他大清早地在城堡走廊里徘徊，神情激动，语无伦次。

corridor.en: He wandered the corridors at night, white-bearded and gaunt in his dressing gown, talking to people who had been dead for decades.
corridor.zh: 他穿着晨衣，顶着白胡子，面容憔悴，在夜间的走廊里徘徊，与那些已经死去几十年的人说话。

corridor.en: There was some grainy CCTV footage that showed a tall-ish man touching the sign at around 1am, but, his companions on the trip said that they didn’t get back until more like 3am, and what’s more, this corridor was well-lit even in the middle of the night, which is very unusual in North Korea.
corridor.zh: 有一段模糊的监控录像，显示一个身材偏高的男子在凌晨一点左右碰了那条标语，但和他同行的旅伴说，他们其实是凌晨三点左右才回到酒店的，而且这条走廊即便在深夜也灯火通明，这在朝鲜是很不寻常的。

colonist.en: The colonists were given every reason to stop trusting the intentions of the British Parliament.
colonist.zh: 殖民地有充分的理由不再信任英国议会的意图。

colonist.en: One of the most influential thinkers for the American colonists was John Locke.
colonist.zh: 对美洲殖民地居民最具影响力的思想家之一是约翰·洛克。

colonist.en: Many of the colonists actually considered themselves to be British.
colonist.zh: 许多殖民地居民实际上认为自己是英国人。

colonist.en: The one who lost America. The one in the musical Hamilton, as a comic, petulant villain who sings about how the colonists will come crawling back to him.
colonist.zh: 那个丢了美洲的人。那个在音乐剧《Hamilton》里出场的人，是一个滑稽、任性的反派，唱着殖民者会如何摇尾乞怜地回到他身边。

colony.en: French Guiana isn’t a French colony. French Guiana is France, technically, legally right now.
colony.zh: 法属圭亚那不是法国的殖民地。从技术和法律上讲，现在的法属圭亚那本身就是法国。

colony.en: Most of these colonies had been established during the 1600s, maybe the early 1700s.
colony.zh: 这些殖民地大多是在17世纪或18世纪初建立的。

colony.en: Unlike Britain’s colonies further south, New France never attracted an enormous number of settlers.
colony.zh: 与更南端英国的殖民地不同，新法兰西从未吸引到数量庞大的定居者。

colony.en: They were both former British colonies. So why are they not one country?
colony.zh: 它们都曾是英国的殖民地。那么为什么它们不是同一个国家呢？

colony.en: At the same time as this, the Australian colonies began to develop their own politics.
colony.zh: 与此同时，澳大利亚的殖民地开始发展自己的政治体系。

constant.en: Although the Cold War did not begin with open fighting, it created constant pressure.
constant.zh: 虽然冷战并不是从公开的战斗开始的，但它造成了持续的压力。

constant.en: He also suffered from poor health which would remain a constant challenge throughout his life.
constant.zh: 他还饱受健康状况不佳的困扰，这将成为他一生中挥之不去的挑战。

constant.en: The city faces many challenges. Traffic congestion and air pollution are constant problems.
constant.zh: 这座城市面临着诸多挑战。交通拥堵和空气污染是常有的难题。

constant.en: Britain found itself in almost constant war with France for the best part of twenty years.
constant.zh: 英国发现自己与法国陷入了长达近二十年的几乎不间断的战争中。

constant.en: This constant movement makes it very difficult to safely land equipment, maintain stability, or accurately mine materials.
constant.zh: 这种持续的运动使得安全降落设备、维持稳定性或精确开采物资变得极其困难。

confusion.en: And there was immediate confusion among federal employees, the government workers who received the email.
confusion.zh: 收到邮件的联邦雇员也就是政府工作人员中立刻产生了困惑。

confusion.en: It may well have intensified his fear, agitation and confusion, and triggered further manic episodes.
confusion.zh: 这很可能加剧了他的恐惧、焦虑和困惑，并引发了进一步的躁狂发作。

confusion.en: To make matters worse, powerful officials exploited this confusion for their own benefit.
confusion.zh: 更糟糕的是，有权有势的官员为了自身利益利用这种混乱。

confusion.en: Spoken language needs to be processed in real time and long questions increase the chance of confusion.
confusion.zh: 口语需要实时处理，冗长的问题会增加产生混淆的几率。

confusion.en: It caused confusion, frustration, and even protests, but eventually, the Gregorian calendar became the global standard.
confusion.zh: 它引起了混乱、沮丧甚至抗议，但最终，格里高利历成为了全球标准。

coincidence.en: Wrangham's claim is that this is not a coincidence.
coincidence.zh: 兰厄姆断言，这绝非巧合。

coal.en: They did not have large resources of oil or coal or iron or anything natural.
coal.zh: 他们没有大量的石油、煤炭、铁或其他任何自然资源。

coal.en: Unlike coal, oil, or natural gas, uranium was not controlled by a single group of countries.
coal.zh: 与煤炭、石油或天然气不同，铀并不受控于某一特定国家集团。

coal.en: The first major step came in 1951 with the creation of the European Coal and Steel Community.
coal.zh: 第一个重大步骤出现在1951年，当时创建了欧洲煤钢共同体。

coal.en: Now, the existence of coal had been common knowledge for centuries.
coal.zh: 其实，煤炭的存在几个世纪以来一直是常识。

coal.en: And this had considerable advantages. Using coal was much cheaper.
coal.zh: 这具有相当大的优势。使用煤炭要便宜得多。

considerable.en: And this had considerable advantages. Using coal was much cheaper.
considerable.zh: 这具有相当大的优势。使用煤炭要便宜得多。

considerable.en: This is actually something that goes all the way back to Aristotle, the 4th-century BC Greek Philosopher who spent considerable time addressing the question of happiness.
considerable.zh: 这实际上可以追溯到亚里士多德，这位公元前 4 世纪的古希腊哲学家曾花大量时间探讨幸福的问题。

county.en: The county sheriff, a man named Johnny Behan, was sympathetic to the Cowboys.
county.zh: 县警长 Johnny Behan 对“牛仔帮”抱有同情。

county.en: The smaller part — the six counties in the north-east — is called Northern Ireland.
county.zh: 较小的部分——东北部的 6 个郡——被称为北爱尔兰（Northern Ireland）。

county.en: And Wyatt Earp had ambitions to become county sheriff himself.
county.zh: 而 Wyatt Earp 自己则一心想当上县警长。

county.en: The territories of the fled earls — six counties across the north of Ireland — were declared forfeit to the English Crown.
county.zh: 逃亡伯爵们的领地——爱尔兰北部的六个郡——被宣布收归英国王室所有。

county.en: Fifty years later, in 1265, the first “semi-modern” parliament was called, when an English Earl called for representatives from counties, or districts, up and down the country, to come to the Palace of Westminster to discuss the management of the country.
county.zh: 五十年后的1265年，召开了第一届“半现代”议会，当时一位英国伯爵召集来自全国各郡或地区的代表来到威斯敏斯特宫，讨论国家管理问题。

complication.en: It’s a similar story with listening, although there are some additional complications and opportunities.
complication.zh: 听力的情况也类似，尽管有一些额外的复杂性和机遇。

complication.en: Now, there is one final thing to mention, and that is an additional complication to do with the unusual structure of the UK.
complication.zh: 现在，还有最后一件事要提，那就是与英国不寻常结构相关的另一个复杂情况。

complication.en: Each of those countries also includes some smaller islands, and there is the added complication of some islands that are something confusing called crown dependencies, but that's too much detail for today.
complication.zh: 这些国家还各自包含一些较小的岛屿，此外还有一些被称为“王权属地”（crown dependencies）的岛屿，情况比较复杂，但今天就不细说了。

complication.en: Plus, there was the complication that there is a region of the country called “The Midlands”, which insisted it was its own region but was often called south by Northerners and north by Southerners.
complication.zh: 此外，还有一个复杂之处：英国有一个被称为“中部地区”（The Midlands）的区域，该地区坚持认为自己是一个独立的区域，但北方人常称其为南方，南方人又常称其为北方。

complication.en: After all, yes there was some external trade, but so long as everyone within a particular settlement or area knew what the date was, it was relatively easy to adjust it without too much complication.
complication.zh: 毕竟，虽然有一些对外贸易，但只要特定定居点或地区内的每个人都知道日期是什么，就相对容易调整而不会有太多麻烦。

convict.en: In 1952, he was arrested and convicted for having a relationship with another man.
convict.zh: 1952 年，他因与另一名男子保持恋爱关系而被捕并定罪。

convict.en: Penn was clearly guilty under the law. But the jury refused to convict him.
convict.zh: 按照法律，佩恩显然是有罪的。但陪审团拒绝判他有罪。

convict.en: This colony was not founded by free British people, but by convicts sent from Britain.
convict.zh: 这个殖民地不是由自由的英国人建立的，而是由从英国发配来的罪犯建立的。

convict.en: He is charged, tried and convicted of belonging to a criminal conspiracy.
convict.zh: 他被指控、受审并因参与犯罪阴谋罪被判有罪。

convict.en: If a government wants to convict someone, a judge is a far easier target than a jury.
convict.zh: 如果政府想给某人定罪，针对一名法官要比针对一个陪审团容易得多。

coalition.en: It also authorised a coalition of countries to use military force to remove Iraqi forces.
coalition.zh: 它还授权一个国家联盟使用军事力量驱逐伊拉克军队。

coalition.en: His army was a multi-ethnic coalition: Libyans, Numidians, Iberians, Gauls, and Carthaginians.
coalition.zh: 他的军队是一个多民族的联合体：利比亚人、努米底亚人、伊比利亚人、高卢人以及迦太基人。

coalition.en: Denard has been hired by a coalition of opposition political parties called the United National Front, six groups united mainly in wanting Abdallah gone.
coalition.zh: Bob Denard 是被一个名为“统一民族阵线”的反对党联盟雇佣的，这个联盟由六个组织组成，联合起来的主要目的就是想让 Ahmed Abdallah 下台。

coalition.en: And perhaps more importantly, why now? Well, the short answer is: the political left, trade unions, and a coalition of pro-immigration and civil rights groups.
coalition.zh: 或许更重要的是，为什么偏偏是现在？简短的回答是：政治左翼、工会，以及一个由支持移民和民权组织组成的联盟。

coalition.en: Supporters say this delivers clear winners and stable governments; in the UK coalitions are quite rare, with only 19 of the past 100 years having a coalition in government.
coalition.zh: 支持者表示，这带来了清晰的赢家和稳定的政府；在英国，联合政府非常罕见，过去100年中只有19年是由联合政府执政的。

consult.en: And he has begun consulting a witchdoctor for advice on matters of state.
consult.zh: 他甚至开始向巫医咨询国家大事的建议。

consult.en: It was only after they consulted photographs of the other high-profile disappearance that year that they made the connection.
consult.zh: 直到他们查阅了当年另一起备受关注的失踪案的照片后，才把两者联系起来。

contract.en: He then awards the business the contract to build a bridge or a road.
contract.zh: 然后他就会把建造桥梁或道路的合同判给这家企业。

contract.en: These bribes were paid so that Siemens would then be given contracts for infrastructure projects.
contract.zh: 支付这些贿赂是为了让西门子能够获得基础设施建设项目的合同。

contract.en: After all, Musk’s companies, like SpaceX and Tesla, have billions in government contracts.
contract.zh: 毕竟，Musk 的公司（如 SpaceX 和 Tesla）拥有数十亿美元的政府合同。

contract.en: So, many of them preferred to drag out conflicts because it meant longer contracts and more money.
contract.zh: 因此，他们中的许多人更愿意拖延冲突，因为这意味着更长的合同和更多的钱。

contract.en: These were societies that needed contracts, charters, and legal expertise.
contract.zh: 这些都是需要合同、特许状和法律专业知识的社会。

command.en: Unlike a large proportion of the young men he commanded, Fawcett survived the Somme.
command.zh: 与他麾下的大多数年轻人不同，Fawcett 在索姆河战役中活了下来。

command.en: But the man who actually holds the power is the one commanding the Presidential Guard.
command.zh: 但真正掌握大权的人，是那个指挥总统卫队的人。

command.en: They also used a lot of short imperative commands, which I mentioned earlier.
command.zh: 他们还使用了许多我刚才提到过的简短的祈使指令。

command.en: Two Roman consuls, each commanding half of the force, led them out to finally crush Hannibal.
command.zh: 两名罗马执政官各率领一半兵力，出征誓要彻底消灭Hannibal。

command.en: These are short, fast commands, and they must be done immediately.
command.zh: 这些是简短、快速的指令，必须立即执行。

conqueror.en: The Ottomans were led by the ambitious Sultan Mehmed II, who is often remembered as “Mehmed the Conqueror.”
conqueror.zh: 奥斯曼人由雄心勃勃的苏丹穆罕默德二世率领，他常被人们铭记为“征服者穆罕默德”。

conqueror.en: In 1066, a group from Normandy in northern France had invaded England under William the Conqueror and taken over the country.
conqueror.zh: 1066 年，一群来自法国北部诺曼底的人在“征服者威廉”（William the Conqueror）的率领下入侵并占领了英格兰。

conqueror.en: And one of the reasons why Machu Picchu is still there, is because it was never discovered by the Spanish conquerors during the colonial period.
conqueror.zh: 马丘比丘至今完好的原因之一，是它在殖民时期从未被西班牙征服者发现。

congratulate.en: Shortly afterwards, Henry II arrived, and not to congratulate him.
congratulate.zh: 随后不久，Henry II 到了，但他不是来祝贺的。

conquest.en: Under her reign, England committed large armies to Ireland with a single goal: full military conquest of the entire island, not just the management of the Pale.
conquest.zh: 在她的统治下，英格兰向爱尔兰派出了大军，目标只有一个：对整个岛屿进行全面的军事征服，而不仅仅是管理“围栏区”。

conquest.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on Mobutu Sese Seko, or to give him his full title, “the all-powerful warrior who, because of his endurance and inflexible will to win, goes from conquest to conquest, leaving fire in his wake.”
conquest.zh: 好了，这就是今天关于 Mobutu Sese Seko（或者用他的全名：“这位全能的战士，由于他的忍耐和不可动摇的获胜意志，从一个征服走向另一个征服，所到之处留下一片火海”）的节目的全部内容。

conquest.en: OK then, that is it for today's episode on Mobutu Sese Seko, or to give him his full title, “the all-powerful warrior who, because of his endurance and inflexible will to win, goes from conquest to conquest, leaving fire in his wake.”
conquest.zh: 好了，这就是今天关于 Mobutu Sese Seko（或者用他的全名：“这位全能的战士，由于他的忍耐和不可动摇的获胜意志，从一个征服走向另一个征服，所到之处留下一片火海”）的节目的全部内容。

column.en: As the Roman column marched along a narrow path at the edge of the lake, his troops launched a surprise attack from the high ground.
column.zh: 当罗马军队沿着湖边狭窄的小径行军时，他的部队从制高点发起了突袭。

column.en: Businessmen who had once been happy to be photographed beside him declined meetings, investors pulled out of the country, and newspaper columns were filled with damning reports.
column.zh: 曾经乐于与他合影的商人们拒绝了会面，投资者撤出了该国，报纸专栏里充斥着 damning 的（罪证确凿的）报道。

column.en: And at the Battle of Yellow Ford in 1598, in the north of Ireland, his forces surrounded and destroyed an entire English army column, killing around two thousand soldiers.
column.zh: 在 1598 年爱尔兰北部的黄福德战役（Battle of Yellow Ford）中，他的部队包围并摧毁了整支英国军队纵队，杀死了约两千名士兵。

conviction.en: He was a deeply religious Protestant, with an absolute conviction that he was doing God's work.
conviction.zh: 他是一个极其虔诚的新教徒，坚信自己是在履行上帝的旨意。

conviction.en: And in 2013, he was granted a royal pardon, formally overturning his conviction.
conviction.zh: 2013 年，他获得了皇家特赦，正式推翻了对他的定罪。

conviction.en: The reaction was fierce. For many people, especially in journalism and the arts, the conviction was an outrage.
conviction.zh: 社会反应极其强烈。对许多人来说，尤其是新闻界和艺术界，这次定罪简直是骇人听闻。

conviction.en: As a result of his conviction, Turing lost his security clearance, meaning he was no longer allowed to work on government projects.
conviction.zh: 由于被定罪，Turing 失去了安全许可，这意味着他再也不能参与政府项目的工作。

conviction.en: Bush and his famously strong convictions, like the existence of Saddam Hussein’s weapons of mass destruction, even if there wasn’t any evidence.
conviction.zh: 布什总统，以及他那些出了名的坚定信念，比如坚信萨达姆·侯赛因拥有大规模杀伤性武器，尽管根本没有任何证据。

conceal.en: Hannibal’s cavalry outflanked them, and a hidden unit he had concealed in nearby reeds attacked from behind.
conceal.zh: Hannibal的骑兵包抄了他们，他藏在附近芦苇丛中的一支隐蔽部队也从后方杀出。

conceal.en: And he did not conceal his contempt for Irish Catholicism.
conceal.zh: 他从不掩饰对爱尔兰天主教的蔑视。

contempt.en: And he did not conceal his contempt for Irish Catholicism.
contempt.zh: 他从不掩饰对爱尔兰天主教的蔑视。

continental.en: Well, By the early 19th century, Napoleon Bonaparte of France had conquered most of continental Europe.
continental.zh: 好吧，到了19世纪初，法国的拿破仑·波拿巴已经征服了欧洲大陆的大部分地区。

continental.en: The Continental Army, which is the army of the United States, didn’t really have much food or clothes or weapons or money.
continental.zh: 大陆军，也就是美国的军队，其实并没有多少食物、衣服、武器或金钱。

continental.en: It's quite different from the more inquisitorial system used in France, Germany, and most of continental Europe, where the judge takes a far more active role in investigating the facts, and where ordinary citizens play a much smaller part.
continental.zh: 这与法国、德国以及欧洲大陆大多数国家所采用的更偏"纠问制"的制度截然不同，在那种制度下，法官在调查事实方面扮演着远为主动的角色，而普通公民所起的作用则要小得多。

condemn.en: He condemned European decadence all while sipping French champagne and collecting fine European art.
condemn.zh: 他一边品尝着法国香槟、收藏着欧洲艺术品，一边谴责欧洲的腐朽。

condemn.en: The Church of England and the Catholic Church condemned it.
condemn.zh: 英格兰教会和天主教会都对这部电影进行了谴责。

condemn.en: Then, in 1711, the government passed a law to restore the rights and good names of many who’d been condemned.
condemn.zh: 接着在1711年，政府通过了一项法律，恢复了许多被定罪者的权利和好名声。

condemn.en: The most famous example is the trial of Socrates in 399 BC, in which five hundred citizens voted to condemn him to death.
condemn.zh: 最著名的例子，就是公元前399年对苏格拉底(Socrates)的审判，当时有五百名公民投票判处他死刑。

condemn.en: Within 18 months, MBS was hosting the G20 summit in Riyadh, where world leaders—including those who'd publicly condemned him—stood side by side with the crown prince for official photos.
condemn.zh: 在18个月内，MBS在利雅得主办了G20峰会，世界领导人——包括那些曾公开谴责他的人——与王储并肩站在一起拍摄官方合影。

concentrated.en: A system of patronage, of centralised power, of wealth concentrated in the hands of a few.
concentrated.zh: 一种裙带关系、权力高度集中、财富集中在少数人手中的体制。

concentrated.en: More and more wealth has become concentrated, owned by, the richest people.
concentrated.zh: 越来越多的财富被最富有的人集中和拥有。

concentrated.en: The result was a huge loss of jobs in these industries, which were concentrated in the north.
concentrated.zh: 其结果是这些集中在北方的产业损失了大量工作岗位。

concentrated.en: The first technique is called packing. This is when opposition voters are concentrated into a single district.
concentrated.zh: 第一种技术被称为“打包”（packing）。这是指将反对派选民集中到一个单一的选区中。

concentrated.en: And social inequality remains visible with wealth concentrated in some areas, while other neighborhoods struggle with poverty.
concentrated.zh: 社会不平等现象依然清晰可见，财富集中在某些地区，而其他街区则在贫困中挣扎。

concerning.en: John Locke had recently published his famous Essay Concerning Human Understanding.
concerning.zh: John Locke 最近刚出版了他著名的《人类理解论》。

commentary.en: It was also a political commentary on a part of America that he said had been left behind: the Rust Belt, which is the stretch of the northeastern and midwestern United States that was once the industrial heartland, but has been in serious decline.
commentary.zh: 这也是对美国某一部分他所说已被遗忘的地区进行的政治评论：铁锈地带（Rust Belt），也就是美国东北部和中西部曾经的工业核心地带，但目前正处于严重衰落之中。

contradiction.en: It could work out contradictions. These were settings that were mathematically impossible.
contradiction.zh: 它可以计算出矛盾项——也就是数学上根本不可能存在的设置。

contradiction.en: Clearly, he was a fascinating character but was full of contradictions.
contradiction.zh: 很显然，他是一个迷人却又充满矛盾的人物。

contradiction.en: And American society contained a lot of contradictions.
contradiction.zh: 而且美国社会包含了许多矛盾。

contradiction.en: Whether that is a damning contradiction or simply the reality of how American politics is funded, well, that’s something you can make up your own mind about.
contradiction.zh: 不管这算是一个致命的矛盾，还是仅仅体现了美国政治资金来源的现实，好吧，你可以自己下定论。

constitution.en: Donald Trump, under the American Constitution, cannot serve more than two terms as President.
constitution.zh: 根据美国宪法，唐纳德·特朗普担任总统不能超过两届。

constitution.en: Eventually, the Constitution was ratified, was approved, and in 1789, the new government began operating.
constitution.zh: 最终，宪法得到了批准，并在1789年，新政府开始运作。

constitution.en: Singapore has elections and a parliament and political parties and a constitution.
constitution.zh: 新加坡有选举、议会、政党和宪法。

constitution.en: On the one hand, the US Constitution gives states the power to draw their own congressional districts.
constitution.zh: 一方面，美国宪法赋予各州划分自己国会选区的权力。

constitution.en: It introduced the Bill of Rights and amendments to its Constitution.
constitution.zh: 它引入了《权利法案》及其宪法修正案。

correction.en: Some markets may see corrections. Others may plateau, or even continue to rise.
correction.zh: 一些市场可能会看到调整。其他市场可能会趋于平稳，甚至继续上涨。

competence.en: And the next generation was huge— dozens upon dozens of princes who had grown up with extraordinary wealth, political connections, and varying degrees of competence.
competence.zh: 而下一代规模庞大——有几十甚至上百位王子，他们在极尽奢华、错综复杂的政治关系和参差不齐的能力中长大。

compound.en: He didn’t spend his teenage years floating between luxury compounds in Europe or the United States.
compound.zh: 他的青少年时期也没有在欧洲或美国的豪华庄园间游荡度过。

compound.en: Compounded, this is an average growth of almost 5% a year, which is significantly higher than the growth in non-minimum wage jobs, which increased at a rate of 2.8% a year.
compound.zh: 复合计算，这相当于每年近 5% 的平均增长，明显高于非最低工资工作的增长，后者的增长率为每年 2.8%。

convention.en: Under the Geneva Convention, they are not considered lawful combatants, so they don’t receive the same protections.
convention.zh: 根据《日内瓦公约》，他们不被认为是合法的战斗人员，因此无法获得相同的保护。

convention.en: If the government loses such a vote, convention says the Prime Minister must either resign or call a general election.
convention.zh: 如果政府在这样的投票中失利，按惯例首相必须辞职或解散议会重新大选。

convention.en: British politics is unusual. It’s old, it’s full of quirky traditions, and it’s based far more on customs and conventions than on a single written rulebook.
convention.zh: 英国政治很不寻常。它历史悠久，充满了奇特的传统，而且它更多地基于习俗和惯例，而不是一本单一的成文规则手册。

cooperate.en: These countries cooperate on decisions, even if they’re not officially part of OPEC itself.
cooperate.zh: 这些国家在决策上进行合作，即使它们并非OPEC本身的正式成员。

cooperate.en: What do you think? Do you think countries should cooperate to control prices of things like oil?
cooperate.zh: 你怎么看？你认为各国应该合作控制像石油这样的东西的价格吗？

cooperate.en: Sure, the United States does not cooperate with terrorists.
cooperate.zh: 当然，美国是不会与恐怖分子合作的。

cooperate.en: The US government has a stated policy of not cooperating with terrorists, and so agreeing to publish one’s manifesto was unusual, to say the least.
cooperate.zh: 美国政府有一项既定政策，即不与恐怖分子合作，因此同意发表某人的宣言，至少可以说是不寻常的。

cooperate.en: This was also one of the moments when the thirteen colonies started to work together and cooperate for the first time.​ The colonists were also debating some really big political questions.
cooperate.zh: 这也是十三块殖民地开始第一次共同协作的时刻之一。殖民地居民还在辩论一些非常重大的政治问题。

corporation.en: Governments and large corporations are also building systems and platforms based on AI.
corporation.zh: 政府和大型企业也在构建基于AI的系统和平台。

corporation.en: Without a fair minimum wage, the most vulnerable in society risk being even more exploited by powerful corporations.
corporation.zh: 如果没有合理的最低工资，社会中最弱势的群体就有可能受到强大公司更严重的剥削。

corporation.en: This is what “universitas” originally meant, not “a university” as we think of today, but a corporation of students.
corporation.zh: 这就是“universitas”最初的意思，不是我们今天认为的“大学”，而是学生的法人团体。

corporation.en: To some, this is a worthy achievement, a law that protects workers from exploitation at the hands of greedy corporations.
corporation.zh: 对某些人来说，这是一项了不起的成就，是一部保护工人免受贪婪公司剥削的法律。

corporation.en: Global corporations have opened offices in Warsaw.
corporation.zh: 全球跨国公司纷纷在华沙设立办公室。

construct.en: Stones from Aztec temples were used to construct churches and palaces and government buildings.
construct.zh: 阿兹特克神庙的石头被用来建造教堂、宫殿和政府大楼。

construct.en: It’s constructed from white marble and decorated with intricate carvings, calligraphy, and precious stones.
construct.zh: 它由白大理石建造，饰有复杂的雕刻、书法和宝石。

construct.en: The government constructed a large number of public houses, affordable public houses.
construct.zh: 政府建造了大量的公共住房，即经济实用的公共住房。

construct.en: The Great Wall was constructed over many centuries by different Chinese dynasties.
construct.zh: 长城是由中国不同朝代历时数百年修建的。

construct.en: The Olmec constructed ceremonial centers with large platforms, plazas and temples.
construct.zh: 奥尔梅克人建造了带有大型平台、广场和神庙的礼仪中心。

consecutive.en: In exchange for avoiding the death penalty, he was sentenced to eight consecutive life sentences without the possibility of parole.
consecutive.zh: 作为免于死刑的交换，他被判处八个连续终身监禁，且不得假释。

compute.en: One of the most prestigious awards in computing, the Turing Award, is named in his honor.
compute.zh: 计算机领域最负盛名的奖项之一——Turing Award，便是以他的名字命名的。

compute.en: It's computing it, creating something new in real time.
compute.zh: 它是在进行计算，实时创造出新的东西。

compute.en: Turing helped lay the foundations of modern computing.
compute.zh: Turing 奠定了现代计算机的基石。

compute.en: That is why environmental campaigners have started to pay attention, because AI use is exploding at breakneck speed, and AI is much more energy-intensive than almost every other consumer technology; each request requires far more computing power, therefore more energy.
compute.zh: 这就是为什么环保活动人士开始关注这一点，因为人工智能的使用正以惊人的速度爆炸式增长，而且人工智能比几乎所有其他消费类技术的耗能都要大得多；每一次请求都需要更强大的计算能力，因此需要更多的能量。

colonel.en: One such officer was Claus von Stauffenberg, a 36-year-old Lieutenant Colonel who had been awarded the Iron Cross for his bravery in the Battle of France.
colonel.zh: 其中一位军官是克劳斯·冯·施陶芬贝格（Claus von Stauffenberg），他是一名36岁的中校，曾在法兰西战役中因英勇表现而被授予铁十字勋章。

colonel.en: The focus quickly switched to a threat from within, and suspicion fell on the man who had entered with a briefcase, then quickly left without one: Lieutenant Colonel von Stauffenberg.
colonel.zh: 焦点迅速转移到来自内部的威胁，怀疑落在了那个提着公文包进来、随后又空手迅速离开的人身上：中校冯·施陶芬贝格。

colonel.en: Lumumba had clearly seen this potential, too, and promoted Mobutu to colonel and soon after, Chief of Staff of the national army - a meteoric rise that gave him enormous influence over the country’s only cohesive institution at the time.
colonel.zh: 卢蒙巴显然也看出了这种潜力，将蒙博托晋升为上校，不久后又任命他为国家军队参谋长——这是一次火箭般的升迁，使他对当时国内唯一的凝聚力机构产生了巨大的影响。

courteous.en: He had met Hitler on several occasions, and Hitler had always been polite and courteous to him; after all, the sacrifices this man had made for the Nazi cause were plain to see.
courteous.zh: 他曾多次见过希特勒，希特勒对他也总是彬彬有礼、客客气气；毕竟，这个人为了纳粹事业所做出的牺牲是有目共睹的。

commander.en: Lawrence rode for days through the desert to deliver the news to British commanders in Cairo.
commander.zh: Lawrence 骑马在沙漠中奔波了数日，将消息传达给开罗的英国指挥官。

commander.en: The transition from unknown boy to commander of the world’s most powerful empire at the time was incredibly smooth.
commander.zh: 从一个默默无闻的男孩转变为当时世界上最强大帝国的统帅，这个过渡异常平稳。

commander.en: A seasoned Roman commander, Publius Cornelius Scipio, fresh from victories in Iberia, led a daring campaign in North Africa.
commander.zh: 一位经验丰富的罗马统帅——刚在伊比利亚取得胜利的普布利乌斯·科尔内利乌斯·西庇阿（Publius Cornelius Scipio），在北非发起了一场大胆的远征。

commander.en: Arrest these supposedly rogue forces, declare martial law, and declare a Field Marshall called Erwin von Witzleben as Commander in Chief.
commander.zh: 逮捕这些所谓的反叛势力，宣布戒严，并宣布一位名叫埃尔温·冯·维茨莱本（Erwin von Witzleben）的元帅为总司令。

commander.en: In 1565, a military commander known as Estácio de Sá founded a new settlement for Portugal on the edge of the bay.
commander.zh: 1565年，一位名叫埃斯塔西奥·德·萨的军事指挥官在海湾边缘为葡萄牙建立了一个新的定居点。

communist.en: Those directly involved in the July 20th plot included nationalists, democrats, aristocrats and communists.
communist.zh: 直接参与7月20日阴谋的人包括民族主义者、民主主义者、贵族和共产主义者。

communist.en: But of course, Warsaw’s post-war identity, Warsaw’s story, was deeply influenced by communist politics.
communist.zh: 但当然，华沙战后的身份认同、华沙的故事，深受共产主义政治的影响。

communist.en: A new communist regime took power, and they were supported politically and militarily by Moscow.
communist.zh: 一个新的共产主义政权上台了，他们在政治和军事上得到了莫斯科的支持。

communist.en: And the continent was now divided between the “democratic” Western Europe and the “communist” Eastern Europe.
communist.zh: 而且，欧洲大陆现在分裂成了“民主的”西欧和“共产主义的”东欧。

communist.en: It represented the collapse of communist control in Eastern Europe.
communist.zh: 它代表了东欧共产主义控制的崩溃。

commute.en: We walk in our cities, shop in stores, and commute at stations without really thinking about how much we’re being watched.
commute.zh: 我们在城市中漫步，在商店里购物，在车站通勤，却根本不会去想自己被监视了多少。

commute.en: The situations in which they tend to be least happy are probably unsurprising: commuting, working in stressful conditions, or when they’re ill.
commute.zh: 他们最不快乐的场景可能并不令人意外：通勤、在压力山大的环境下工作，或者生病的时候。

collective.en: Collective security is the belief that all countries should work together to stop aggression and protect peace.
collective.zh: 集体安全是指这样一种信念：所有国家应当共同努力来制止侵略并保护和平。

collective.en: One of the main ideas was collective security.
collective.zh: 其中一个核心理念就是集体安全。

collective.en: By analysing billions of words on social media, or even the emotional tone of song lyrics, they attempt to track collective happiness in real time.
collective.zh: 通过分析社交媒体上的数十亿个单词，甚至是歌曲歌词的情感基调，他们试图实时追踪集体幸福感。

collective.en: Now they’re not. There are now huge opportunities for education and wealth in the country, and the Chinese government has even promoted the phrase the “Chinese Dream “, although it does tend to be a bit more on national success and collective progress
collective.zh: 而现在他们不再贫困了。中国现在拥有巨大的教育和财富机遇，中国政府甚至还推广了“中国梦”这一说法，尽管它往往更偏向于国家成功和集体进步。

correlate.en: Spending time with other people, perhaps unsurprisingly, is positively correlated with self-reported happiness.
correlate.zh: 不出所料，花时间与他人相处与自我报告的幸福感呈正相关。

correlate.en: And in the same report, household size is positively correlated with happiness, up to a point at least.
correlate.zh: 在同一份报告中，家庭规模与幸福感呈正相关，至少在一定程度上是这样。

compose.en: Once they composed themselves, perhaps they revealed a joke they'd just been told, or a funny story they had just heard about someone they knew.
compose.zh: 等他们平静下来后，也许会分享刚刚听到的一个笑话，或者关于他们认识某人的趣事。

consul.en: His consuls, who were sitting next to him, asked him why he was laughing.
consul.zh: 坐在他身旁的执政官问他为什么笑。

consul.en: Two Roman consuls, each commanding half of the force, led them out to finally crush Hannibal.
consul.zh: 两名罗马执政官各率领一半兵力，出征誓要彻底消灭Hannibal。

consul.en: These two consuls, two of the highest elected officials of the Roman Empire, presumably knew that Caligula was deadly serious.
consul.zh: 这两位执政官，作为罗马帝国职位最高elected officials中的两位，大概知道 Caligula 是绝对认真的。

contemporary.en: Aztec ruins lie beneath skyscrapers. Colonial churches stand beside contemporary museums.
contemporary.zh: 阿兹特克人的废墟静静躺在摩天大楼下方。殖民时期的教堂与当代博物馆比邻而立。

contemporary.en: And if you want to see the modern British food revival, go to a great gastropub or a contemporary British restaurant.
contemporary.zh: 如果你想见识现代英国食物的复兴，可以去一家棒极了的美食酒吧（gastropub）或现代英国餐厅。

contemporary.en: In any case, the first few months of his rule were, as one contemporary historian put it, a "Golden Age" of happiness and prosperity.
contemporary.zh: 无论如何，正如一位当代历史学家所说，他统治的头几个月是一个充满幸福和繁荣的“黄金时代”。

contemporary.en: I had to search online for common slang terms used today because I don’t really use much slang in my English, and I especially don’t use contemporary slang in my daily vocabulary.
contemporary.zh: 我不得不上网搜索今天常用的俚语词汇，因为我在英语中其实不太使用俚语，而且我的日常词汇中尤其不使用当代俚语。

congress.en: The Republican party in Texas wants to gain more seats in Congress.
congress.zh: 得克萨斯州的共和党希望在国会中获得更多席位。

congress.en: Congress would make the laws. The president would enforce the laws.
congress.zh: 国会制定法律。总统执行法律。

congress.en: Discretionary spending is the only category that is “optional”, which can be increased or decreased by Congress.
congress.zh: 可自由支配支出是唯一的“可选”类别，可以由国会增加或减少。

congress.en: This is often used in parliaments and congresses, when a party wants to stop a law from passing.
congress.zh: 这经常用于议会和国会，当一个政党想要阻止一项法律通过时。

consideration.en: There are a few other things I take into consideration too, like whether a story can be properly told in an audio-only format.
consideration.zh: 我还会考虑其他一些因素，比如一个故事是否适合仅通过音频形式来讲述。

consideration.en: The country was treated as a vast resource mine— rubber, copper, uranium, diamonds—all extracted for Belgian profit, with practically zero consideration for the livelihood or well-being of any of the native people.
consideration.zh: 这个国家被当作一个巨大的资源矿——橡胶、铜、铀、钻石——全部为比利时的利益而被疯狂掠夺，几乎完全不考虑任何当地人的生计或福祉。

consideration.en: Some, like if you are talking about works of art or geographical borders, just don’t work quite so well without images, so I’ll also take that into consideration, and that’s the reason there aren’t many episodes about art.
consideration.zh: 有些话题，比如艺术品或地理边界，如果没有图像就没那么好理解，所以我也会考虑到这一点，这也是为什么关于艺术的节目不多的原因。

conquer.en: Then there were the Gauls, the recently conquered or allied tribes from southern France.
conquer.zh: 还有高卢人，也就是刚刚被征服或归附的法国南部部落。

conquer.en: It is a city built on water. That was conquered, rebuilt, expanded, and modernized.
conquer.zh: 这是一座建立在水上的城市。它曾被征服、重建、扩建并现代化。

conquer.en: But across the ocean, another empire had begun to explore and conquer new lands.
conquer.zh: 但在海洋的另一端，另一个帝国已经开始探索并征服新的土地。

conquer.en: Some politicians in the US believed that conquering Canada would be easy.
conquer.zh: 美国的一些政客认为征服加拿大易如反掌。

conquer.en: Well, By the early 19th century, Napoleon Bonaparte of France had conquered most of continental Europe.
conquer.zh: 好吧，到了19世纪初，法国的拿破仑·波拿巴已经征服了欧洲大陆的大部分地区。

costly.en: A siege, he knew, would be long and costly, and his army had never been particularly good at sieges.
costly.zh: 他深知围城战将旷日持久且代价高昂，而且他的军队向来不擅长攻城。

confrontation.en: Rather than face Hannibal in open battle, they avoided direct confrontation.
confrontation.zh: 他们不再与Hannibal进行正面决战，而是避免直接对抗。

confrontation.en: In some cultures, being too direct can sometimes sound rude or insensitive, so euphemisms are a way to avoid confrontation or embarrassment or discomfort.
confrontation.zh: 在某些文化中，过于直接有时听起来很粗鲁或缺乏同理心，所以委婉语是避免对抗、尴尬或不适的一种方式。

copper.en: Beneath the DRC lies enormous deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, tin, and coltan.
copper.zh: 刚果（金）地下蕴藏着巨额的铜、钴、黄金、钻石、锡和钶钽铁矿储量。

copper.en: These include resources such as oil, natural gas, gold, diamonds, and copper.
copper.zh: 这些资源包括石油、天然气、黄金、钻石和铜等。

copper.en: And when there was a crash in the price of copper, which was one of Zaire’s main exports, the country literally ran out of money.
copper.zh: 当作为扎伊尔主要出口产品之一的铜价暴跌时，国家简直陷入了山穷水尽的地步。

copper.en: The Democratic Republic of Congo is one of the wealthiest countries in the world in terms of its natural resources, with huge deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, and other precious metals.
copper.zh: 就自然资源而言，刚果民主共和国是世界上最富有的国家之一，拥有巨额的铜、钴、金、钻石和其他贵金属储量。

corrupt.en: Individual corruption happens when one person abuses their position, when one person is corrupt.
corrupt.zh: 个体腐败发生在一个个人滥用其职位、一个人出现腐败行为的时候。

corrupt.en: Enormous amounts of money can go missing through embezzlement or other corrupt practices.
corrupt.zh: 巨额资金会通过挪用公款或其他腐败行径凭空消失。

corrupt.en: Many young officers, including Mustafa Kemal, started to realise that the Ottoman system was outdated, corrupt, and incapable of modernising.
corrupt.zh: 许多年轻军官，包括穆斯塔法·凯末尔，开始意识到奥斯曼体系已经过时、腐败且无力实现现代化。

corrupt.en: So if a country discovers oil or other valuable materials, is it automatically going to become corrupt or economically dependent on that resource?
corrupt.zh: 因此，如果一个国家发现了石油或其他宝贵物质，它会自动变得腐败或在经济上依赖该资源吗？

corrupt.en: No. He was egregiously corrupt, and he and his allies siphoned off huge amounts of the country’s wealth and stashed it in Swiss banks and foreign property.
corrupt.zh: 不，他极其腐败，他和他的盟友掠夺了该国巨额财富，并将其藏在瑞士银行和外国房产中。

compensation.en: They even paid some money to the families, a token compensation payment by way of apology.
compensation.zh: 他们甚至向这些家庭支付了一些金钱，作为一种象征性的赔偿和道歉方式。

consumption.en: It was a booming industry, and the average Roman senator’s daily perfume consumption would probably even put a member of the Kardashian family to shame.
consumption.zh: 这是一个蓬勃发展的行业，平均一个罗马参议员每天消耗的香水，大概会让卡戴珊（Kardashian）家族的成员都感到汗颜。

compass.en: They crossed thousands of kilometers of open ocean in a large double-hulled canoes without compasses, maps, or modern instruments.
compass.zh: 他们驾驶着大型双体独木舟，在没有指南针、地图或现代仪器的帮助下，横渡了数千公里的开阔海洋。

compass.en: He was probably right. He returned to Britain, traded his machete and compass for an officer’s uniform, and headed into the trenches of northern France.
compass.zh: 他可能没想错。他返回英国，脱下砍刀和指南针，换上军官制服，一头扎进了法国北部战壕的泥潭中。

compass.en: It is, on one level, highly visible. There are buildings, called Masonic lodges, that you can see in many towns and cities, as they are typically marked by the iconic square and compass symbol.
compass.zh: 从某个层面来看，它是高度可见的。你在许多城镇都能看到被称为共济会会所的建筑，因为它们通常带有标志性的方矩和圆规符号。

coincide.en: Putin’s first term as President coincided with a boom in oil prices, which was very good news for a country where oil and gas make up a fifth of the economy.
coincide.zh: 普京的第一任总统刚好赶上了油价暴涨，对于一个石油和天然气占经济五分之一的国家来说，这无疑是个好消息。

conform.en: The results seemed to show that ordinary people could quickly conform to roles of authority or submission, even in a short period of time.
conform.zh: 结果似乎表明，普通人即便在很短的时间内，也会迅速顺应权威或服从的角色。

concentration.en: These asteroids are essentially the leftover building blocks of planets, and many contain high concentrations of metals that didn’t make it into planetary cores.
concentration.zh: 这些小行星本质上是行星遗留的积木，许多都含有高浓度的、未能进入行星核心的金属。

concentration.en: It was a convenient explanation and would help rationalise the behaviour of things like prison guards in Nazi concentration camps, and later on, would be used to explain the atrocities at Abu Ghraib prison in Iraq.
concentration.zh: 这是一种很方便的解释，后来被用来为纳粹集中营看守的行为做合理化解释，再往后，又被用来解释伊拉克阿布格莱布监狱的暴行。

concentration.en: In an atomic bomb, with a large concentration of highly enriched Uranium-235, this causes a huge, destructive explosion, but if it could be done with uranium that was less enriched, then the energy given out by the reaction could be controlled and converted into usable energy.
concentration.zh: 在原子弹中，由于高度浓缩的铀-235高度集中，这会引起巨大的、具有毁灭性的爆炸，但如果使用的是浓缩程度较低的铀，那么反应释放出的能量就可以得到控制，并转化为可用的能源。

collision.en: These elements were created during supernova explosions and collisions of neutron stars—cosmic events that forge the universe’s heaviest and most valuable materials.
collision.zh: 这些元素是在超新星爆炸和中子星碰撞过程中产生的——这些宇宙事件锻造出了宇宙中最重、最有价值的物质。

collision.en: Fortunately, we humans are better than dinosaurs at spotting potential threats in the sky, so in the event of an asteroid looking like it was on a collision path with Earth, we would know about it pretty quickly and be more capable than a diplodocus of changing its trajectory.
collision.zh: 幸运的是，我们人类比恐龙更善于发现天空中潜在的威胁，所以如果真的有小行星看起来正处于与地球相撞的轨道上，我们能很快察觉到，并且比梁龙更有能力去改变它的运行轨迹。

cosmic.en: These elements were created during supernova explosions and collisions of neutron stars—cosmic events that forge the universe’s heaviest and most valuable materials.
cosmic.zh: 这些元素是在超新星爆炸和中子星碰撞过程中产生的——这些宇宙事件锻造出了宇宙中最重、最有价值的物质。

contradictory.en: In practice, though, it’s a position that’s evolved in fascinating and, sometimes, contradictory ways.
contradictory.zh: 但在实践中，这个职位却以迷人且有时甚至是矛盾的方式发展着。

contrived.en: This was famously summed up by the first Vice President, John Adams, who is reported to have said that the Vice Presidency was “the most insignificant office that ever the invention of man contrived.”
contrived.zh: 首任副总统John Adams对此曾有过一句名言，据报道他说副总统是“人类发明过的最微不足道的职位”。

container.en: And even going back thousands of years, people knew what they needed to explore the deep: some kind of container and a source of air.
container.zh: 即使追溯到几千年来，人们也知道他们探索深海需要什么：某种容器和氧气来源。

compress.en: There is absolutely no way a human body could withstand that sort of pressure; our organs would be instantly crushed, we would be compressed to a fraction of our normal size and, to state the obvious, instantly killed.
compress.zh: 人类的身体绝对无法承受这种压力；我们的器官会被瞬间压碎，我们会压缩到正常体型的一小部分，显而易见，会瞬间死亡。

comparative.en: The legendary French maritime explorer and filmmaker Jean-Michel Cousteau once said that we understand the other side of the moon better than we understand our own oceans, so while we know more about it than ever before, the deep sea still is a comparative unknown that holds more questions than answers.
comparative.zh: 传奇的法国海洋探险家和电影制片人让-米歇尔·库斯托（Jean-Michel Cousteau）曾说过，我们对月球另一面的了解胜过对我们自己海洋的了解，所以尽管我们对它的了解比以往任何时候都多，但深海仍然是一个相对未知的领域，它带来的问题多于答案。

conserve.en: The spectre of industrial action loomed large, with miners’ strikes crippling the nation and leading to the implementation of the three-day working week in an attempt to conserve electricity.
conserve.zh: 罢工潮的阴影笼罩着全国，矿工罢工使国家陷入瘫痪，为了节约用电，政府甚至实施了每周三天工作制。

counterpart.en: And the Southern man looks down on his Northern counterpart as something of a savage, an uncivilised barbarian.
counterpart.zh: 南方男人则瞧不起北方人，把他们看作未开化的野蛮人。

counterpart.en: The Australians had contacted their British counterparts before making the arrest, to ask how they could confirm whether it was indeed Lord Lucan.
counterpart.zh: 澳大利亚警方在实施逮捕前联系了英国同行，询问如何确认此人是否真的是 Lord Lucan。

counterpart.en: There are stark wage and productivity gaps between the North and the South, with people in London earning an average of ⅓ more than their Northern counterparts, and productivity of workers in London being 40% higher than those in the North.
counterpart.zh: 南北之间存在巨大的工资和生产率差距，伦敦人的平均收入比北方同胞高出三分之一，而伦敦工人的生产率比北方工人高出40%。

comprehend.en: Teachers are pretty good at comprehending a variety of different accents and also interpreting your mistakes.
comprehend.zh: 老师非常擅长理解各种不同的口音，也能解读你的错误。

comprehension.en: How can you test someone’s comprehension of a joke or their ability to detect sarcasm?
comprehension.zh: 你怎么能测试一个人对笑话的理解力或他们察觉讽刺的能力呢？

comprehension.en: And we’ll do this while practicing our English listening comprehension and learning some new vocabulary!
comprehension.zh: 我们将在练习英语听力理解和学习一些新词汇的同时完成这一切！

comprehension.en: Maybe it makes you seem strange. When it comes to idioms, focus on comprehension first.
comprehension.zh: 这或许会让你显得很奇怪。说到习语，首先要专注于理解。

comprehension.en: And we’ll do this while practicing your English listening comprehension and learning some new vocabulary!
comprehension.zh: 我们将在练习英语听力理解和学习一些新词汇的同时，来完成这一切！

comprehension.en: So, let’s understand corruption while improving our English listening comprehension and learning some new vocabulary!
comprehension.zh: 那么，就让我们在提升英语听力理解能力、学习一些新词汇的同时，来理解什么是腐败吧！

compulsory.zh: 各国政府逐步推行义务教育。

conception.en: This was quite different from the European conception of government.
conception.zh: 这与欧洲对政府的概念截然不同。

consent.en: It argued that governments derive their powers from the consent of the governed.
consent.zh: 它认为政府的权力源于被统治者的同意。

consent.en: The land that they had cared for and managed for tens of thousands of years was taken without their consent and turned into farms or mines.
consent.zh: 他们精心呵护和管理了数万年的土地在未经他们同意的情况下被夺走，变成了农场或矿山。

complexity.en: I could have simple conversations. I did not see the complexity of the language, so I assumed I was doing well.
complexity.zh: 我能进行简单的对话。我没有看出这门语言的复杂性，所以我以为自己干得不错。

commonwealth.en: Poles, Lithuanians, Jews, Ukrainians, Germans, Armenians, and many other communities lived inside the Commonwealth.
commonwealth.zh: 波兰人、立陶宛人、犹太人、乌克兰人、德国人、亚美尼亚人以及许多其他群体都生活在联邦境内。

commonwealth.en: Gradually though, the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth became weaker, especially during the 1700s.
commonwealth.zh: 不过渐渐地，波兰立陶宛联邦开始走向衰落，尤其是在 18 世纪期间。

commonwealth.en: This led to the Federation of Australia in 1901 when six separate colonies joined together to form the Commonwealth of Australia.
commonwealth.zh: 这促成了 1901 年的澳大利亚联邦成立，当时六个独立的殖民地联合起来组成了澳大利亚联邦。

commonwealth.en: It does, however, remain part of the Commonwealth and the Australian Head of State is King Charles, the same king who is King of England and King of Canada and King of New Zealand.
commonwealth.zh: 不过，它确实依然是英联邦的一部分，澳大利亚的国家元首是查尔斯国王，也就是同时担任英国国王、加拿大国王和新西兰国王的那个国王。

confirmation.en: That’s very important. When you need a confirmation or you need a final answer, closed questions are much more effective.
confirmation.zh: 这非常重要。当你需要确认或需要一个最终答案时，封闭式问题要有效得多。

confirmation.en: “How does this usually work?” If your goal is understanding, rather than confirmation, open questions are almost always the better choice.
confirmation.zh: “这个通常是怎么运作的？”如果你的目标是理解而非确认，开放式问题几乎总是更好的选择。

cooperative.en: Research consistently shows that follow-up questions make conversations more engaging and more cooperative.
cooperative.zh: 研究一再表明，追问会让对话变得更引人入胜、更有协作性。

concise.en: A good question is clear and concise. The listener should immediately understand what you are asking without needing clarification.
concise.zh: 一个好问题应该清晰简明。听众应该不需要别人解释就能立即听懂你在问什么。

courage.en: Her work required a lot of patience, precision, and also courage.
courage.zh: 她的工作需要极大的耐心、精确度，还有勇气。

courage.en: Theseus became the new king of Athens. To honor his journey and his father’s death, the people of Athens kept the ship as a symbol of courage and heroism.
courage.zh: 忒修斯成为了雅典的新国王。为了纪念他的旅程和父亲的死，雅典人民将这艘船作为勇气和英雄主义的象征保留了下来。

contend.en: One side holding that the ship remained the same and the other contending that it was not the same.”
contend.zh: 一方认为这艘船保持不变，另一方则争辩说它已经不是同一艘船了。”
